summary: Localess is a self-hosted translation management system and content management system designed to handle multilingual text for applications and websites. It integrates AI-assisted translation workflows to help you generate and manage target-language content more efficiently. The project is distributed under the MIT licence and provides containerised deployment options.
goodFor: Development teams or content managers who need a centralised, self-hosted platform to coordinate translation pipelines and AI-assisted localisation workflows.
watchOut: With a relatively modest community following and a moderate maintenance health score, you may need to rely on the existing codebase for troubleshooting rather than extensive community support or third-party documentation.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
